info.name: Apache Detection
author: philippedelteil
info.description: Some Apache servers have the version on the response header. The OpenSSL version can be also obtained

request:
GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: rs-target
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/129.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
Accept: */*
Accept-Language: en
Accept-Encoding: gzip
response:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK Content-Length: 225 Accept-Ranges: bytes Content-Type: text/html Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 19:03:12 GMT Etag: "e1-65e7255a38d60" Last-Modified: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 18:50:16 GMT Server: Apache/2.4.49 (Unix) Test

Login

admin
curl-command: curl -X 'GET' -d '' -H 'Accept: */*' -H 'Accept-Language: en' -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/129.0.0.0 Safari/537.36' 'http://rs-target/'
